summary: Cred provides a market update analyzing BTC, ETH, and overall crypto market. BTC is lagging with slow, grindy price action while ETH leads the rally showing strong strength. The market is in an altcoin season with ETH merge speculation driving volume and interest. Tech sector (SP500, Nasdaq) is rallying and positively correlated with crypto.
